description: Text the customer pasted (a book's slip, a chat or note list, Rocky's "Game 1: ... / Player — 8+ Rebounds (-225)" format) read exactly as the app's Grade › Paste reads it: legs with market, selection, line, odds, player, stat and game, printed same-game groups, stake, payout, book and intent. Then each leg is matched by the app's own leg match (match.status matched | event_only | ambiguous | unmatched, eventId, marketId, catalog market) and the account's default region. A DraftKings or FanDuel link answers kind link with the url for ticket_actions from_link. Reads only; saves nothing.
name: read_pasted_slip
title: Read a pasted betslip
